text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (Kgh... My legs feel so heavy. Even so—)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(I cannot afford to lose this battle. If I 
lose, everything will have been in 
vain...!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...You've got to be kidding me!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Royce and Royce! Taking first place 
is Royce and Royce!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah... ...Did I win...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
! I really... won, didn't I...! I'm so 
relieved...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... The trembling is only hitting me 
now... If I had lost, it would've been the 
end of everything...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Thank goodness...

"With a light step, I head toward Royce 
and Royce's waiting room. When suddenly—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah! The great Maestro!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah! The great Maestra!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Brillante! A melody overflowing with light 
is both a hymn of triumph and an overture 
to glory!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Praise be to the wonderful music!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ciao!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I won!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you did it! That was a great run!
Yeah, you did it! That was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu... Is that so? Well, the real deal 
starts now!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If I deliver a pathetic run at the Japan 
Derby, people might write me off as all 
talk.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Putting up a good fight against 
Taishin-san and the others. That's all 
part of my producer plan!"
choice_data_list:
Everyone said they're really looking 
forward to the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Wait, really?
choice_data_list:
There were people rooting for you to win 
too, Royce!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh my... Ufufu, well, yes. I think my 
running was quite good today too.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Haven't I finally gotten strong enough to 
compete with Taishin-san and the others?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ufufufu! Next up is finally the 
Japan Derby, isn't it!
